state:Andhra Pradesh.text: Andhra Pradesh is aggressively pursuing AI infrastructure development, anchored by massive investments from tech giants like Google and Reliance in hyperscale data centres located in Visakhapatnam [R42588509, R1349768b, R064e3178]. The state government is also institutionalizing advanced education and capacity building through partnerships with NVIDIA, IBM, and Microsoft to establish specialized universities and upskill hundreds of thousands of youth and school teachers [R06697b72, R9fe15d9b, R5237da05, Re98842fe]. Furthermore, artificial intelligence is being integrated extensively across public administration, public safety, healthcare, and tax compliance to drive governance reforms and state revenue monitoring [Rd4cc8595, R6e71a6d9, Rb4490cf5, R65671ccc].

state:Bihar.text: The Government of Bihar has aggressively advanced its AI policy landscape by signing multi-crore investment MoUs at the India AI Impact Summit and partnering with technology giants like Google and Microsoft to train teachers and upskill youth [R44971ae6, R1b5b6306, Rd71e810d]. The state has integrated artificial intelligence into diverse governance sectors, implementing AI tools for school education, public health tracking, public distribution systems, and infrastructure safety [Reb7bfdb3, R6e6fb2b1, Rac954476, R3749bccb]. Furthermore, administrative processes are being modernized through initiatives like an upcoming paperless e-Cabinet system and broader AI adoption directives for government institutions [Re986d143, R2a1cfea2].

state:Gujarat.text: Gujarat has heavily invested in artificial intelligence infrastructure, policy frameworks, and governance applications, establishing specialized initiatives like data centre policies targeting Green AI capacity alongside GPU-as-a-Service and sovereign park proposals [Re041bd74, R43f4ae2b, Rd1b68bba, Rb40e306d]. The state government has integrated AI across various sectors, ranging from agricultural and educational platforms to police surveillance hackathons and crime tracking tools [Ra310e3fc, R88fee491, R28ccc09b, Rd78856c5]. Meanwhile, institutional bodies like the Gujarat High Court have engaged with the technology by enacting policies that prohibit AI use in judicial decision-making while addressing challenges related to AI-generated citations [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has pursued extensive AI integration across governance, infrastructure, and education through public-private partnerships and institutional initiatives [Re78dfed2, R65d60606, Ra7ba747a]. The state has advanced plans for an Artificial Intelligence University, established multiple Centres of Excellence, and initiated large-scale infrastructure projects such as the Bidadi AI Township alongside affordable AI computing devices like the KEO computer [Rc16dddf8, Re78dfed2, R3590a0eb, R9082b90f]. Educational reforms feature the introduction of AI curricula starting from Class 6 in government schools, alongside vocational subjects and targeted skilling programs [R8176ca19, R3e7508f6, R0e4ecbd7]. Furthermore, administrative applications range from AI-powered attendance tracking and digital crop surveys to voice AI citizen services leveraging platforms like Bhashini [Rf518fff6, Ra61ec765, R9d27904f].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through comprehensive policy approvals, substantial fiscal investments, and institutional reorganizations including a dedicated IT and AI department [R562864e1, Rd7d40f74, Rbff13ca0]. The state government has launched major governance and infrastructure initiatives such as the 'Maha AI' platform, sovereign AI tools, and massive data centre projects alongside public-private partnerships with technology giants like Google and Microsoft [R04592b70, R68fee1a0, Re0b416d1, R03b6b6d6]. Sector-specific applications span across agriculture, cybercrime investigation, public health, education, and transport, supported by newly established oversight committees and regulatory frameworks [R04592b70, R2889d124, Rb96d46bb, Rda62f74e, R5afedf9c].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha is rapidly advancing its AI infrastructure by approving major projects like sovereign compute facilities, semiconductor units, and large-scale AI data centers involving firms such as HCLTech, Adani Group, and Sarvam AI [R31b27cb7, R78b0f274, R00b3c6a6, Rdf1e1271, R3a36bb44]. The state government is actively integrating artificial intelligence into public administration and citizen services, deploying numerous WhatsApp chatbots including 'Ama Sathi', 'Ama Rasta', and 'Agni Saathi' [Rabdf8555, R478c8c67, Rd9e884dc]. Additionally, Odisha is strengthening AI education and skills development by introducing specialized curricula across schools and higher education institutions, alongside implementing AI-driven monitoring for wildlife protection and law enforcement [Rdb5da3c5, R7b1537aa, R499f4234, R05090e42].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued extensive artificial intelligence integration across education, governance, agriculture, and law enforcement. The state has incorporated AI into school curriculums through the Punjab School Education Board for classes spanning from primary levels up to Class XII, alongside launching AI-driven career guidance and hosting student hackathons [Rf6319e99, R18b7190d, R11fad9f5, Rc24de481]. In law enforcement and public safety, the Punjab Police has deployed AI-powered voice recognition systems, smart command centres, and real-time tracking partnerships with IIT Ropar to crack down on organized crime [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77, Re289fcd5]. Additionally, the state has adopted AI applications for healthcare screening, agricultural advisories, and infrastructure monitoring, though courts have placed limits on relying purely on AI tools for legal show-cause notices and judicial judgments [R8eacd504, R3d477cff, Ree614b14, R609b6fc5].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has significantly advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure projects, including partnerships for a Sovereign AI Park and an AI-ready data center campus [R472c3c1a, R70cb396d]. The state government has also integrated AI across public services and welfare schemes, such as deploying WhatsApp chatbots for healthcare and governance, and launching AI warning systems to prevent wildlife collisions on railway tracks [R576baa19, R494484b4, R31409be3]. Furthermore, education and workforce readiness are core priorities, marked by specialized AI training initiatives for government school teachers and students [Ra3121dfd].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has aggressively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major investments in data center infrastructure, partnerships with tech giants like Microsoft, and the establishment of applied AI centers of excellence [R998e03d5, Ra0d04f11, Rd164dad2]. The state government has integrated AI across various public administration sectors, utilizing AI tools for revenue enforcement, traffic and emergency management, agricultural market tracking, and driving license testing [Ra1409382, R45e372bd, R849548ed, R867da268]. Additionally, Telangana has prioritized large-scale digital skills training and educational initiatives to equip millions of students and government employees with AI competencies [R6843cc3b, R3bfd0d73, R59295049].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh is actively advancing its artificial intelligence landscape through major infrastructure projects, governance integration, and expansive workforce training programs. Significant initiatives include the approval of an AI and robotics park in Greater Noida, the development of an AI City in Lucknow, and massive multi-billion dollar memoranda of understanding for data center hubs [Rb1cbd4df, Rbcca7384, Rad45bc42]. The state government has also launched specialized missions and policies, such as the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission and the Data Centre Policy 2026, alongside deploying AI-powered surveillance for competitive exams and government administration [Rb312992b, R398131aa, R840f85d3]. Furthermore, partnerships with major technology firms support extensive skilling campaigns aimed at training millions of youth in emerging technologies [R10e7268a, Rc6148c8c, Rd114762d].

category:strategy_policy.text: State governments have actively formulated comprehensive artificial intelligence policies, missions, and infrastructure initiatives to strengthen regional digital ecosystems and economic growth [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, Rb312992b]. Significant investments and policy frameworks include Maharashtra's approved AI policy backed by ₹10,000 crore, Chhattisgarh's ₹500 crore AI Mission, and Gujarat's green AI data centre and infrastructure policies [R7cc53f61, R562864e1, R43f4ae2b]. States are also prioritizing large-scale workforce readiness by introducing student AI training programs, specialized startup hubs, and educational overhauls across multiple regions [R4af400f2, Ra6932da2, R5c2eec42]. Furthermore, several administrations are integrating artificial intelligence into public governance, administrative workflows, and sector-specific applications such as agriculture and disaster management [R8f4114ad, R3391f5dc, R45e372bd].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and high courts have actively introduced regulatory frameworks and guidelines to address the ethical challenges, data privacy concerns, and risks associated with artificial intelligence. Notably, the high courts of Gujarat and Kerala, along with the Punjab and Haryana High Court, have restricted or prohibited the use of AI tools in judicial decision-making, judgment drafting, and issuing notices to preserve public trust and prevent reliance on non-existent case laws [Rbd9766bd, R12b7585e, R3cc78d30, R8eacd504, R3d477cff, Rd45f0fb4, Re909a24e]. Meanwhile, states like Karnataka, Rajasthan, Telangana, and Maharashtra have focused on responsible AI adoption by establishing ethics committees, drafting data governance frameworks, and issuing restrictive circulars to protect confidential taxpayer and student data from unauthorized platforms [R9b3c768e, R607d069a, R3f7241e3, Ra75d01a2, Rdff5f567, R680564f5]. Additionally, several administrations have targeted synthetic media misuse, implementing mandatory labeling for AI-generated content, tackling deepfake scams, and addressing digital safety concerns for students and citizens [Raf4f7b8d, R7c216cfc, R783d943c, Rf972ff43].

category:funding_budget.text: State governments have driven substantial financial commitments toward artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centres, and specialized missions across India. Major allocations include Chhattisgarh approving a Rs 500 crore AI Mission over five years [R7cc53f61], Maharashtra clearing Rs 11.26 crore to roll out Sarvam AI tools for government users [R68fee1a0], and Uttar Pradesh introducing a Rs 2,000 crore AI Mission alongside a Rs 1,725 crore skill development scheme [R297b1b1d, R0c270c1c]. States are also securing massive private sector investments, such as Odisha approving a ₹22,634 crore sovereign compute project alongside large-scale data centre proposals [R00b3c6a6, R78b0f274], and Andhra Pradesh approving a Rs 31,387 crore green AI data centre [R3eefbde9]. Additionally, targeted sector investments feature initiatives like Maharashtra's Rs 500 crore MahaAgri-AI Policy for agriculture [R5c8784f8] and Gujarat's ₹20 crore AI training program for students [Ra6932da2].

category:infrastructure.text: Indian state governments are aggressively scaling up AI infrastructure through massive investments in hyperscale data centers, green energy campuses, and specialized compute hubs [R31b27cb7, R5b4a7a80, R42588509]. States like Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Odisha have approved multibillion-dollar projects and policy frameworks—such as Uttar Pradesh's Data Centre Policy 2026 and Gujarat's Data Centre Policy 2026-29—to attract global tech giants and accelerate local compute capacities [R398131aa, Re041bd74, R657bba09]. Additionally, regional administrations are building dedicated AI cities, sovereign parks, and innovation hubs to bolster deep-tech ecosystems, research, and public sector adoption [R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a, Re78dfed2, Rf4058825].

category:partnership.text: State governments across India have actively pursued partnerships and MoUs with major technology firms and research institutions to build AI infrastructure, data centres, and innovation hubs [R44971ae6, R42588509, Reff5d158]. Significant investments and agreements focus on establishing large-scale AI compute facilities, Sovereign AI parks, and Centers of Excellence alongside international and domestic tech leaders [R472c3c1a, R212c0bcb, R998e03d5]. Additionally, several states have signed collaborative agreements aimed at public service delivery, healthcare integration, and training educators and youth in artificial intelligence and digital skills [Reb7bfdb3, R494484b4, Rf88612cd].

category:deployment.text: State governments are actively deploying artificial intelligence across public services, governance, and infrastructure to enhance efficiency and administration [Rd731fc75, R8f4114ad]. Key initiatives include the implementation of multilingual chat bots and voice portals for citizen services and language preservation, as well as AI-driven systems for healthcare, traffic management, and law enforcement [Rabdf8555, R3158dd4a, R0689eb15, Rd78856c5]. Additionally, states are leveraging AI for exam surveillance, revenue tracking, and disaster preparedness to strengthen operational transparency [2, R6e71a6d9, Ra8c17a13].

category:skilling.text: Indian state governments are actively driving AI skilling initiatives through school curricula reforms, teacher training partnerships with tech giants, and broad youth training programs. States like Punjab and Karnataka have introduced AI as a mainstream or early-grade subject in schools [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19], while states such as Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Gujarat have rolled out massive targets to train hundreds of thousands of youth and educators in artificial intelligence [R4af400f2, Rb312992b, Ra6932da2]. Furthermore, several states including Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, and Assam have forged strategic partnerships with major technology companies like Google and Microsoft to build labs and upgrade digital literacy [R5956406b, R2889d124, R3fff65a8].

category:events_outreach.text: State governments have actively engaged stakeholders through numerous AI summits, conclaves, and expos, such as the regional conferences held in Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, and Odisha [R4d3bfbb9, Reb9a8d36, Rfad375dd]. Authorities have also launched targeted hackathons, youth workshops, and skill initiatives to foster innovation and digital governance across regions like Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Tripura [R28ccc09b, Rfe753238, R3fff65a8]. Furthermore, major events like the Bengaluru Tech Summit and the National Conference on e-Governance in Rajasthan have served as key platforms for discussing AI integration and strategic partnerships [R6abb0164, R7317a3e2].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, education, law enforcement, and infrastructure development. The state government rebranded its IT department to focus on AI and future technologies, established twin AI Centres of Excellence, and attracted major investments such as a large AI-driven data centre [Rcaa18758, Ref58a154, Ra525c46d]. In the public sector and judiciary, authorities integrated AI-assisted administrative overhauls, translation and transcription tools, and traffic monitoring systems alongside robotics and cyber safety protocols [Rf2c35456, R8f4114ad, Raf4f7b8d, R70b2d101]. Educational programs have also seen widespread AI integration, ranging from specialized school training and robotics mandates to generative AI tools for students and teachers [R0689eb15, R3db21292, Rb2b9a51b, Rc3656b09].

category:governance_body.text: Several Indian states have established high-level ministerial portfolios, specialized departments, and dedicated governance bodies to spearhead artificial intelligence initiatives [R6bbe2d82, R2dd69e13, R6f0677ec]. States such as Kerala and Tamil Nadu have appointed dedicated AI ministers and rebranded traditional IT bodies to focus on future technologies and AI-driven growth [Ref58a154, Ref475c84, R1b255da2]. Additionally, numerous administrative committees, task forces, and expert panels have been formed across regions like Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Gujarat to oversee policy formulation, ethical usage, and multi-departmental coordination [R9b3c768e, R5afedf9c, R301d6af1]. Law enforcement and security agencies in states including Telangana, West Bengal, Haryana, and Jharkhand have also created specialized AI cells and task forces to enhance policing operations and data-driven investigations [Ra1409382, Re268e526, Ra6b5d331, R25c27df1].

overall.text: Indian state governments are actively implementing artificial intelligence policies, infrastructure projects, and educational initiatives spanning data centers, governance tools, and school curricula. Major infrastructure investments include massive data center campuses, AI cities, and sovereign AI parks launched or planned across states like Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Odisha [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, R562864e1, R42588509]. States are also heavily focusing on education and workforce skilling by introducing AI subjects, training portals, and early tech programs for students [Rf6319e99, R4af400f2, R8176ca19]. Additionally, regional administrations are adopting AI for public service delivery, law enforcement copylines, multilingual portals, and healthcare monitoring [Rd731fc75, R04592b70, Rad868781, R93ba67d7].

state:Assam.text: Assam has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across governance, public services, and infrastructure, establishing a foundational AI roadmap and a government-owned GPU cluster to power state services [R936eb0aa, R4203359c]. The state government partnered with Google to build an AI Centre of Excellence and launched large-scale teacher training initiatives alongside digital attendance and monitoring tools in schools [Red858166, R39b50ddb, R9c3a4d8c]. Additionally, Assam has deployed AI applications for public safety, environmental conservation, and disaster management, including flood rescue platforms and wildlife protection systems [R9c52da90, R037e76ac, R692a244d].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh is actively advancing its digital infrastructure through major investments, including a Rs 500 crore allocation for the Chhattisgarh Mission alongside large-scale data center park developments [R7cc53f61, Recb4eed4]. The state has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors such as education and wildlife management, highlighted by Google-supported teacher training initiatives and AI-powered elephant tracking systems [R398fad0d, R96ea213d]. Furthermore, law enforcement and public administration are utilizing AI tools for crime detection, road monitoring, and internal audits [Reb028d74, R1dec6260, R71e1d0ae].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has advanced its technology-driven governance framework through major initiatives such as the Haryana AI Development Project and plans for an AI data centre and sandbox environments [R127f881c, R56704031, R03b25e4d]. The state government is integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including a police modernization plan focused on cybercrime tracking, drone-driven surveillance models, and AI-backed tools for tuberculosis screening and agriculture [Ra6b5d331, Rdb9464b3, Rf90e65a4, R8677362d]. Additionally, educational reforms are introducing AI and vocational subjects into schools, Industrial Training Institutes, and upcoming digital colleges in Gurugram and Panchkula [Rcd5e27a7, Rf9aabd25, Rb029010f].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, education, healthcare, and environmental management [Re82f2564]. Significant initiatives include launching the 'Padhai with AI' digital learning platform for students, deploying AI tools for forest intelligence and resource mapping, and upgrading public welfare systems like Himcare to prevent fraud using machine learning [Rb23a865a, Rd81af6f6, Rc3a3d3b4]. Additionally, the state has adopted AI-driven administrative platforms, meeting management systems, and specialized security and health infrastructure to enhance public service delivery [R1ba6a5ba, R1cf417a8, Reb98bbcd].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced its digital governance landscape through the implementation of the Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 and the Jharkhand AI Vision-2050 roadmap, securing significant investment MoUs and partnering with major tech firms [R2269e1a7, R7694c76a, R927ec078, Rf5068d47]. The state has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, deploying AI tools in the judiciary, healthcare modernization, education, and security surveillance during public events like Shravani Mela [Rb7cd9ee5, Re675872a, Rfd41fa83, R96eaad17, R95bbe8d6]. Additionally, administrative frameworks have been expanded to include AI-driven monitoring for wildlife conservation, infrastructure development, and real-time tracking of government schemes [R36a0ee65, Rde702427, R558f4a5f, R6988332a, Rd53d5e43].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across public governance, infrastructure, and security initiatives under Chief Minister Mohan Yadav's administration [R005881fc, Ra1d8b5a3]. Key developments include partnering with Google Cloud for AI-driven governance and event management for the Simhastha Kumbh, establishing large-scale AI data centers, and deploying advanced surveillance like the award-winning 'Trinetra' system [R12d4ab71, 085470af, R6473839f]. The state has also utilized AI for real-time forest monitoring, public procurement audits, and health screenings [Rc8beb73d, R37a735c1, R3df90696]. Additionally, investments in semiconductor and chip packaging facilities reflect the state's expanding technological capabilities [Rd5bd5d63, R4df0843d].

state:Manipur.text: Manipur has advanced its digital governance and artificial intelligence adoption through strategic partnerships and sector-specific applications, including a collaboration with Microsoft and a multilingual AI MoU with the Digital India BHASHINI Division [R8e91e0e8, Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. The state has integrated AI across multiple domains, such as launching translation applications like 'Ishaan', exploring AI to curb wildlife trafficking, and applying technology to tribal development and tourism [R7249ca9d, R49d826c3, R3413274d, Re9f95033]. Furthermore, academic institutions and the judiciary have embraced these innovations, highlighted by research workshops at Manipur University and the Manipur High Court utilizing AI for legal research [R546f135d, R647a600d].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, education, agriculture, and public health, positioning itself as a leader in tech-driven development [Radc3741c, Rf1f88f85, R84a1eeb7]. Significant actions include drafting a new IT policy focused on AI and global capability centres, proposing a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence at Shillong Technology Park Phase II, and introducing AI-enabled learning initiatives in schools [R9625f972, Rf277c3a3, R24be49c9]. Additionally, the state has leveraged data-driven governance to improve public health metrics, deployed AI solutions for environmental and waste management, and hosted the Regional Artificial Intelligence Impact Conference [Rac5495f0, Rd7994ab1, R84a1eeb7].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura is actively advancing artificial intelligence integration across multiple sectors, aiming to launch a state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a robust technological ecosystem [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state has introduced several educational initiatives, including free AI courses for school students, robotics and VR labs, and an AI-powered school monitoring system [R3fff65a8, R12023632, R311a6da8, R20047d48]. Furthermore, the government is deploying AI to enhance public services, governance, healthcare diagnostics, and law enforcement traffic and security management [R8edb04a8, R2235629e, Rbf61a3aa, Rdc265ce0].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand is actively advancing artificial intelligence integration across governance, education, environmental management, and public safety. Key state initiatives include mandating AI education across universities, deploying AI voice portals for local languages, and utilizing AI-based tools for forest surveillance and wildlife conservation [R3158dd4a, Rcea6d545, Rfadf7808]. Additionally, the government has launched AI-powered mechanisms to curb tax evasion, handle cyber crime complaints, and secure public portals against fraud [Recb1f69d, R549f779d, Rc3235cc0]. Major events like the Devbhoomi AI Summit and various digital empowerment summits further highlight the state's strategic push to position itself as a hub for responsible artificial intelligence [R2d4fffde, R8a719696, R042443f1].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively driving AI integration across industrial, educational, and governance sectors, anchored by initiatives like the West Bengal AI Mission and a draft industrial policy focusing on data centres and semiconductors [R0c1ea7de, R90ad9af5, R2f526d3f]. Law enforcement and civic administration are leveraging artificial intelligence through specialized police AI cells, investigation apps, surveillance training MOUs, and exploration of AI for urban infrastructure [Re268e526, Rebcdd9ec, R5118fef0, R08e415eb]. Additionally, the state is expanding educational capabilities by introducing AI curricula in schools and forming workforce upskilling partnerships with entities like Oracle [Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1].

state:Rajasthan.text: Rajasthan has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through policy measures like the approved AI-ML Policy 2026 and foundational training programs to support public administration and skill development [R6a6bee70, R2c694631]. The state government has extensively integrated AI into agriculture through partnerships with Wadhwani AI and automated crop monitoring to enhance farm productivity [R6de84b70, Red667749]. Furthermore, AI technologies are being deployed across policing, traffic management, healthcare tracking, and public grievance redressal platforms such as Rajasthan Sampark [Rd7e6b721, Rc8ca6b6e, Rb6d56877, Rcaf01e51].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland has actively advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, agriculture, and public services since late 2025. Significant actions include the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence for Skilling by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, the launch of an AI-powered Unified Digital Agriculture Ecosystem, and the unveiling of the Eliona AI Supercomputer for disaster preparedness [R6f55ee54, R3a286812, Ra8c17a13]. Additionally, the state has integrated AI into law enforcement via number plate reading cameras and improved service delivery through WhatsApp chatbots [R17676278, R1ee21379]. Educational and capacity-building efforts feature faculty development workshops, student hackathons, and plans for school curriculum reforms [Rb7d1d850, R8a5917e4, R212a4f6f, Ree819f7b].

state:Sikkim.text: Sikkim's AI policy activity spans multiple sectors, notably featuring transport modernization through an AI-driven Traffic Management System and related e-challan systems, which have also prompted public SOP adjustments [Re7e20a6f, R815aacbb, Ref56657c]. Educational and administrative initiatives include launching foundational learning programmes in government schools, collaborating with Google for higher education, and partnering with NIELIT Gangtok to establish an AI Centre of Excellence [R27258895, R604d927c, Red4520ff]. Additionally, the state has explored artificial intelligence applications for boosting tourism via permit systems, supporting agriculture, disaster prediction, and workforce empowerment [R540c7737, Rfc6c0173, Rb685bb8f, R2569fc2d, R9d2c21a3].
